name: 06-basic-ipv6
note: Densest option mix in the corpus: sysctl, both ipv6="True" and ipv6="False" quoted variants, explicit MAC, bridged, port, num_terms. pc1..pc3 have no .startup and are addressed by radvd on r1/r2, so their SLAAC addresses and the DAD tentative flag are daemon-learned; both are filtered out of the addr probe (NORMALIZATION.md section 7). Everything static — fe80::1 / fe80::2, the pinned MACs, the accept_ra sysctl — stays byte-exact.
